[s]Original text[/s]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27507?tab=description]Hello! This is an unofficial 1.6 update for "Rydell the Merman," created with the original author's permission. For details, please refer to the original mod page: New NPC Rydell.
Compatible with the vanilla Tier 2 and Tier 3 farmhouses, as well as "Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse" and "Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2 (Unofficial Update)."

How to unlock Riddel: Visit the beach on the 5th, 10th, 15th, 20th, or 25th of Spring, between 9:00 AM and 5:30 PM. If you miss this, you will have to wait until the following year.


A few notes:

The original mod features two story branches, but the author has currently only completed one. To experience the full storyline, please select the option **"Take Rydell home"** during the initial encounter event.
All events occurring after taking Rydell home require you to upgrade your farmhouse at least once.
There are eight endings in total. In the "bad" endings, Rydell will **leave** Stardew Valley; he only becomes a marriage candidate if you achieve a "good" ending. There are two variations of the good ending, depending on your friendship level.
One specific event requires you to own a cat.
Two "R18" (adult-content) events must be manually enabled in the configuration file.
Requires a "High-Definition Portraits" framework mod as a prerequisite!!! Please search for how to use it yourself.

Installation:
Download all the required prerequisite mods listed and place them, along with this mod, into your `Mods` folder.
If you are adding this to an existing save file and have previously installed the Rydell mod, you must first delete the old version. Then, enter the following command into the SMAPI console: `debug killnpc Rydell`. Please be aware that this command will wipe your existing data for this character (potentially resulting in duplicate sprites if not done correctly), so proceed with caution.[/url]

Adjusting Rydell's location inside the farmhouse:
If you are using the vanilla farmhouse or other layouts, go to `Assets/Schedule/schedule` and modify the coordinates following `"default":`.
If you are using "Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse," modify the file located at `Assets/Schedule/schedule1`.
If you are using "Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2 (Unofficial Update)," modify the file located at `Assets/Schedule/schedule2`.

The portrait replacer shown in the preview images is from: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20094]**Rydell New Portraits**.[/url]
